image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2025
summary: This table presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three months and nine months ended December 31, 2024, and December 31, 2023. It includes key financial metrics such as revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating profit, and net profit, along with their year-over-year growth rates. For the three months, revenues decreased from ₹41,764 crore to ₹38,821 crore, while net profit after minority interest showed a decline from ₹6,806 crore to ₹6,106 crore, reflecting a year-over-year growth of 11.6%. The nine-month figures indicate a similar trend, with revenues of ₹122,064 crore for 2024 compared to ₹115,748 crore for 2023, marking a growth of 5.5%. The operating margin percentage and earnings per share (EPS) are also detailed, highlighting the company's financial performance over these periods.
